current_activity: in position on Hill 49, east of the Matanikau, in general support
notes: Miller, ch. XI: on 10 January 1943 the 89th Field Artillery Battalion (105-mm howitzers), assigned to general support (and later to the 161st Infantry when that regiment was committed to mopping up), selected positions on Hill 49, a high bluff east of the Matanikau River. Miller, Appendix E, lists an 88th Field Artillery Battalion with the 25th Division; the narrative and the December strength table name the 89th, which is the unit entered. A landing day is not copied. Confidence 0.5: Miller only in this increment.
